rows.note: NOT MEASURED, no in-game probe yet. Wall test scene (a wall at 5 m, a band behind it, a near and a far ball) run for every combination of the rig's DepthSource (ResolvedDepth, GlobalDepthTexture) and of Scatterer (present, absent; the second is a start of its own with disableMods Scatterer). A handler of Hooks.RegisterAfterUpscalingWithDepth reads the depth texture back: render size, RFloat, and it holds both near and far pixels (not the 1.19 of an overwritten texture in K-pre P6). The result is 1 only if all four combinations are, and the lines name which failed. Until it has run the API text says [VERIFY] about what the copy holds.

NOT MEASURED. In the same wall test: the read-back depth of the near ball against the far ball. 1 where the near ball has the larger value (reversed Z, as the text of ReDefinitionSampleSceneDepth and Hooks says [VERIFY]), 0 where the smaller. A 0 turns the texts around; the function itself follows UNITY_REVERSED_Z either way.

NOT MEASURED (the wall test scene is not built). Hidden-pixel count of the magenta band behind the wall, drawn with the depth hook, against the geometric expectation, relative (tools/weather_metrics/hooks.py: hidden_pixels_expected, relative_error); camera fixed, no jitter dependence beyond the 3 x 3 nearest tap.

NOT MEASURED. Frames until the temporal error is back to its floor after a forced weather cut (Frame.RequestHistoryReset "weather cut" through a level step above 0.3); the figure of hooks.py frames_to_clear on the per-frame difference to a reference frame. Variants dlss and fsr3 (this row and the next), each with the reset on and off: off must linger past 3 frames, or the test proves nothing.
NOT MEASURED. As the DLSS row, with FSR 3.

NOT MEASURED. The procedure is the comment of CloudDensityCalibration: at five or more uniform coverage values (0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1) the light probe measures the transmission along the sun ray (clouds on against off), the estimate's Shape is read at the same place, CloudDensityCalibration.TryFit returns the factor and the worst relative error of the transmissions. The fit table goes to tests/data/c24-tau-fit.json and the factor into CloudDensityCalibration (TauAtFullCoverage, and TypeDensityReference once the cloud-type densities the log prints per body are used); the [VERIFY] marks go with it. Until then TauAtFullCoverage 3 is a guess.
NOT MEASURED. The coverage values the fit was made from (Fit.Points); fewer than five do not satisfy Fit.WithinBound.
NOT MEASURED. The measured vertical depths rise with the estimate's shape over the coverage steps (Fit.Monotone).
NOT MEASURED. Recorded, no bound: the fitted TauAtFullCoverage.

NOT MEASURED (timing, exclusive: gpu_lock --exclusive). The raytracing segment with the weather inputs on against off, in clear air; benchmark group rt-weather with the weather effects off in one phase and the fog switch on, both quality costs off.
NOT MEASURED (timing, exclusive). Recorded, no bound: the raytracing segment in a blizzard (level 0.9) with the fog on the rays against the phase rt-weather-fog-off of the group rt-weather.

NOT MEASURED. Recorded: the mean luma of a sky reflection (water or a glossy part) with the weather forced to level 0.19 and to 0.21 (the fog is handed over from 0.2, RtWeatherMath.LevelFloor), fog on against off. A step at 0.2 shows the sky miss taking the fog's colour in light fog [VERIFY]; the fix would be a fog layer height or a ramp.

NOT MEASURED (timing, exclusive). Recorded, the figure for the owner's agreement: the raytracing segment in a blizzard with the reach cap (phase rt-weather-reach-cap) as a share of the plain phase. The brief's estimate is 0.5 to 0.7 for both costs together [EST].
NOT MEASURED (timing, exclusive). As the reach cap's row, for phase rt-weather-fewer-bounces.
NOT MEASURED (timing, exclusive). As the reach cap's row, for phase rt-weather-both-costs; the bound says only that the costs do not make the segment longer.

NOT MEASURED. Recorded, then bounded: the mean absolute difference of the frame in the phases with a quality cost against the plain phase, same camera, seed and UT, on the difference region. The threshold is stored with the first measurement (tests/data/c24-rt-difference-threshold.json) and the owner is asked for agreement on the two costs with this figure and the segment shares beside it.
NOT MEASURED. Time until the RT sun shadow under a forced cell follows the visible cloud (L2 forced cell above a vehicle, --exclusive); K-W4a repeats it once.

NOT MEASURED. Ray Reconstruction's onset lag after a light change, with Ray Reconstruction on. If it smears for about a second the AmbientFactor changes are handed over as a light-change event (NightAdaptation) [VERIFY]; 3 iterations at most.

NOT MEASURED. Snow cover under raytracing keeps its roughness (RtTerrainColour, RtMaterialIntent): the reflection of a snow-covered terrain pixel is rough, not a mirror, in the pad scene with the cover forced on [VERIFY].

NOT MEASURED. Recorded: the sun in the rays under a cloud shadow with RtWeatherMath.DoubleDarkeningWeight 0, 0.5 and 1 (three variants of the constant) against the darkening of EVE's own screen-space cloud shadow on the same pixels; the weight that makes the product of both match the cloud's transmission replaces the 0.5 [VERIFY].
